items.definition: to bring a feeling, memory, or image into the mind

examples.source: The photograph evokes a sense of loss without showing anything dramatic.
examples.translation: Das Foto ruft ein Gefühl von Verlust hervor, ohne etwas Dramatisches zu zeigen.

examples.source: Great music can evoke emotion before we know how to explain what we are hearing.
examples.translation: Großartige Musik kann Gefühle hervorrufen, bevor wir erklären können, was wir hören.

examples.source: The film deliberately evokes childhood wonder and adult unease at the same time.
examples.translation: Der Film ruft bewusst zugleich kindliches Staunen und erwachsene Unruhe hervor.

pages.text: At first glance, the exhibition looked almost modest. There were no giant digital spectacles, no theatrical soundtrack leaking from hidden speakers. Yet the show began to work on visitors slowly. One room held a set of small photographs that seemed to evoke childhood memory without stating exactly whose memory it was. Across from them hung an intricate paper installation whose composition pulled the eye inward, line by line. Nothing shouted, yet several works continued to stand out long after people had left the gallery.

Part of the excitement came from the fact that many pieces were deliberately open to interpretation. A film sequence with almost no dialogue left viewers arguing in whispers, while a painter across the hall managed to capture the mood of loneliness using only three dominant colours. Another artist had drawn inspiration from family archives and local myths, combining them in a bold mixed-media series that felt intimate without becoming sentimental.

As we moved from room to room, the role of symbolism became more apparent. Repeated shapes and recurring objects formed a quiet vocabulary of grief, repair and desire. What impressed me most was not a single masterpiece, but the intelligence with which the curator had allowed very different works to converse. The exhibition trusted its audience enough not to explain everything, and that trust felt refreshing.
